LIST.summary: Returns the names of all commands, subcommands included.
LIST.complexity: O(N) where N is the total number of commands.

reply_schema.description: Lowercase command names. Subcommands are named container|subcommand.

arguments.name: filterby
arguments.summary: Keeps only part of the list.

arguments.name: module-name
arguments.summary: Commands of a module. Kronotop has no module system, so the result is always empty.

arguments.name: category
arguments.summary: Commands in an ACL category, for example read or bucket. An unknown category gives an empty result.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.summary: Commands whose name matches a glob pattern. Case-insensitive.
